recap.text: Genesis and Rapture keep Corcunda, a half-mantaur and friend to Dong Quixote, asleep by spell in a burgundy GTO. A Split Personality spell divided him into Corky and Porky. Grigori joins the two halves together in a moving vehicle while Carl drives up walls and across ceilings. Corcunda puts his scarf around Dong's neck and they attack Grull together using a Big-Ass Magnet.

beats.headline: Dong's friend, on somebody else's team
beats.text: Genesis and Rapture, two womantaur dominators, make an appearance and go off to the Hairpin bar. The third member of their team is the one that matters here: a half-mantaur, and he is the friend Dong Quixote is always talking about. Corcunda. A quest opens on the spot to put the two of them back in the same room, which is my way of saying production has noticed that a crawler's mercenary is in love and has decided to sell tickets.
beats.gist: Genesis and Rapture go to the Hairpin bar with Corcunda, a half-mantaur and friend of Dong Quixote.

beats.headline: Asleep in the back seat
beats.text: Subject is in the back seat of the Lady Dominators' burgundy GTO at the top of the hill, curled up and hanging out of the side, with an Unconscious notification over his head. He has not fallen asleep during a race. He has been put to sleep, by spell. Crawler Carl walks past him on the way to look at the boss, notes it, and says nothing. His employers have a wide shield over the car.
beats.gist: Corcunda sleeps in the back of a burgundy GTO under an Unconscious notification.

beats.headline: Dong falls ill at the door
beats.text: Dong tries to get inside the Lady Dominators' garage to reach him and goes down ill on the way. He is carried to Imani. The quest ticks over to its second stage anyway, which nobody on that driveway earned. Imani's reading is that this is not any ordinary sickness. Dong is in withdrawal, and the thing he is withdrawing from is the company of his own sentient sock. I record what the healers tell me. I do not always enjoy it.
beats.gist: Dong falls ill trying to enter the Lady Dominators' garage and is carried to Imani.

beats.headline: There are two of him
beats.text: The shape of the problem, finally stated out loud. Corcunda is not one person in one place. A spell called Split Personality went off a long time ago and split him in two, and both halves lived through it: Corky, riding in the back of the Lady Dominators' car, and Porky, hopping on a single foot behind the doors of the stage performance guild, which Crawler Carl has just sung his way into. Porky agrees to the reunion. Porky also has terms, and the terms are that somebody afterwards answers for how this happened, and that somebody is Dong.
beats.gist: A spell called Split Personality split Corcunda into Corky and Porky.

beats.headline: Pulled out of the hole
beats.text: Corky, recovered from the wreck by Princess Donut, arrives in the back of Crawler Carl's truck unconscious, strung out, and cooking inside his own suit, since the Dominators' containment had failed. A doll hitches in on him. Carl throws it out and tears a patch of suit away with it, and a health bar appears. Grigori clears both debuffs. Corky wakes, asks whether the race is over, and is told to lie still, because his other half is beside him and it is time. He calls for Dong.
beats.gist: Princess Donut recovers Corky from a wreck. He arrives unconscious in Carl's truck. Corky calls for Dong.

beats.headline: The ritual, at speed
beats.text: Grigori performs the joining on a moving vehicle while Crawler Carl drives it up the walls and across the ceiling through the dolls and the slag elementals. It works. The halves close, two suits become one mantaur, and Corcunda is whole for the first time in a long time. He gets a moment of it. Then Grull enters the realm to smite him.
beats.gist: Grigori joins two suits into one mantaur while Carl drives a vehicle through dolls and elementals.

beats.headline: He goes to meet the smite, and says it out loud
beats.text: Corcunda knows what the mark over him means: the smite is his, and Grull will not leave until it lands. So he says the rest out loud, in front of every one of them. He never stopped loving Dong Quixote, and now he has to go to Grull. He puts his scarf around Dong's neck. Dong tells him he is not leaving his side again. The two of them go at Grull together, Dong riding. Crawler Donut throws Big-Ass Magnet onto Dong's lance, every screw for two hundred meters comes to meet it, and Grull goes back to the twelfth floor the hard way.
beats.gist: Corcunda and Dong Quixote attack Grull together, and Crawler Donut uses Big-Ass Magnet to repel Grull.
